title: Sales executive
description:
\*Job Description – Sales Executive

\*Position:\*

Sales Executive – 3 Positions

Sales executive is required in **Interior designer company** 

\*Experience:\*

0 – 3Years

\*Job Responsibilities:\*

\* Handle walk\-in customers and lead enquiries

\* Visit apartment projects and sites to generate new leads

\* Explain interior design packages and company services

\* Conduct client meetings and site visits

\* Coordinate with design, execution, and purchase teams

\* Follow up with leads and convert them into bookings

\* Maintain client relationship and sales records

\* Achieve monthly sales targets

\*Required Skills:\*

\* Basic knowledge of home interiors and modular concepts

\* Basic sales and customer handling skills

\* Good communication and convincing ability

\* Ability to understand customer requirements

\* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and WhatsApp follow\-ups

\* Positive attitude and team coordination skills

\* Freshers or candidates with sales knowledge can apply

\* Interior industry experience is an added advantage

Identify and generate new business leads through field visits.

Meet prospective and existing customers to present products/services.

Build and maintain strong client relationships.

Conduct market research to identify potential customers and competitors.

Negotiate pricing and close sales deals.

Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.

Prepare daily visit reports and update CRM/sales records.

Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction.

Follow up on inquiries and provide excellent after\-sales support.

\*Salary:\*

₹15,000 – ₹35,000/month

(Incentives available based on performance)

\*Benefits:\*

\* Mobile Recharge Allowance

\* Provident Fund

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
